issues.detail: Editor is revealed inline well below the invoking Add/Edit button; no editor focus/scroll handoff or cancel return-focus code appears. This is a source-level potential discoverability gap, not a demonstrated keyboard failure.

issues.detail: Initial paused query with no retained payload is not identified distinctly: the adapter checks source.isLoading but not dataState.isRefreshBlocked/isPending; it can route to domain empty/ready content. OwnershipBrief also groups paused initial work under generic loading/not-computed. Actual offline rendering is unexercised.
issues.fix: Extend the existing domain adapter's explicit unavailable/offline presentation using DataState.isRefreshBlocked; preserve placeholders, retry and retained payloads. Never fabricate exposure or policy values.

visualIssues.detail: Risk curve and gradient hardcode bright #22d3ee, with 0.45 upper opacity; this bypasses current chart palette and user theme choices.
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing chart palette/gradient contract and subdued fill, retaining the score series, numeric axis, tooltip and export/table data.

visualIssues.detail: Policy row and digest use fixed-white border/background rather than neutral semantic variables. Evidence rows repeat it in the shared domain trailer. Actual light-theme contrast not measured.
visualIssues.fix: Replace with canonical semantic surface/border tokens, preserving complete policy metadata and full hash.

visualIssues.detail: Contribution annotation uses raw text-xs; digest uses raw p/text-sm/font-mono; MoneyInput suffix repeats text-xs. Most page text already uses Text roles.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse Text/Caption/Code roles with semantic element overrides and tabular/monospace behavior retained.

architectureIssues.detail: Page owns local 30/90/180/365-day analysis state and selector; assigned route is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS, so shell range is disabled. Hook/handler accept window_days only. This is not two simultaneously visible pickers, but it conflicts with shared dated-page range ownership.
architectureIssues.fix: Coordinate typed backend both-bound support and shared workspace registration before adopting useRangeState; retain window semantics and server calculations, no client-only slicing or fictional start/end endpoint.

architectureIssues.detail: Form survives workspace vehicle changes, but submit attaches the current vehicleId. Editing vehicle A then selecting B can submit A's policy fields against B; no form/vehicle binding or reset effect appears. This is a source-backed risk, not an executed mutation.
architectureIssues.fix: Bind editor draft to the vehicle at open time and prevent unintended cross-vehicle writes; use the existing confirmation mechanism if discarding a dirty draft on scope changes.

architectureIssues.detail: editPolicy updates fields only when a policy exists. After editing/removing a policy or changing vehicle to one without a policy, Add policy can reuse an old draft. Successful save closes without resetting it, and cancellation likewise leaves it intact.
architectureIssues.fix: Define explicit draft retention/reset rules per vehicle and new-versus-edit mode; initialize a new policy deliberately without altering established defaults or silently carrying another policy's fields.

architectureIssues.detail: Score/contribution/projected saving declare sortable=true, but neither DataTable instance supplies onSort, sortKey, sortDir or sortFn. Shared DataTable renders sort buttons only when onSort exists. Declared sorting is therefore not wired at this source snapshot.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing controlled table sorting with explicit raw numeric accessors and stable source ordering as default; keys such as contribution/save do not equal wire fields.

architectureIssues.detail: Trend description promises rolling score and loss cost, while chart and accessible columns expose risk_score only. RiskTrendPoint has loss_cost_index, distance_m and drive_count. Do not assume another existing loss-cost series exists.
architectureIssues.fix: Resolve copy/data intent while preserving the current score trajectory; retain loss-cost metadata in an accessible table/detail if presenting it, without inventing an axis or measurements.
